_edit: Arles. `summary` is the one line on the plaque; `description` is the two lines inside the case study. Facts, tools, role, year. No outcome claims unless you can back them.
title: Selected work

works.title: Outplayed.in
works.role: Product & UI/UX design, Fraemerate Pvt. Ltd.
works.summary: Communities, tournaments and payouts in one mobile app.
works.description: A mobile app for India's competitive gaming scene. Players find communities, teams and tournaments; organisers run an event from registration through to payout. Ten screens and the design system underneath them.
works.alt: The Outplayed.in case study cover: the headline "The ultimate hub for gamers and tournament hosts" on an electric blue ground, beside three app screens — a splash screen, a communities directory, and a tournament page for Weekend Warmup 1.0.

works.title: Fraemerate
works.summary: Identity and site for a digital product studio.
works.description: The mark is five kinked bands stacked into a diamond. The rest of the system is built to stay out of its way.
works.alt: The Fraemerate studio mark: five ribbon-like bands stacked into a diamond, each kinked in the middle, in bone white on a near-black ground.

works.title: Google-Themed Portfolio
works.summary: A portfolio laid out as a search results page.
works.description: The query is my name and the answers are the work. Overview, Projects, Skills, Achievements and Contact become result tabs; a knowledge panel carries the facts nobody wants a paragraph for.
works.alt: A portfolio designed to look like a Google search results page: the search field reads "koyal borbora", and the results are a name, a role, tab pills, a photograph and knowledge-panel cards.

works.title: On-Demand Mechanic
works.summary: Live tracking and job workflow for roadside repair.
works.description: Watch the mechanic approach on the map, see them arrive, then follow the job through Reached, Inspection and Repair. Light and dark treatments.
works.alt: Three phone screens for an on-demand mechanic app on a teal ground: a live map tracking the mechanic, and two versions of the arrival screen showing a job timeline.

works.title: Weather App
works.summary: A weather app built around the forecast, not the thermometer.
works.description: Hourly along the middle, five days below it, and the current temperature given the space it actually deserves.
works.alt: A mobile weather app interface: a large temperature over Jorhat, Assam, an hourly strip, and a five-day forecast shown as temperature bars.
